_comment: Copy to config/targets.json (gitignored) and fill the competitor URLs/labels with your REAL targets. The FILTERS below (icp regexes, job titles, relevance/bait keywords, caps) are the VALIDATED weekly config — keep them as-is to reproduce the standard results; see docs/RUNBOOK.md. Keep employer-specific competitor names/URLs OUT of git (they live only in targets.json). Retarget to a different ICP via docs/ADAPTING.md.

engagement._comment: Mix company-page and exec-profile URLs; exec profiles yield far better cost-per-ICP. competitor_label maps each target URL -> the competitor name shown in the Competitor column (use your REAL competitor names in targets.json; placeholders here).

jobs._comment: Broad seed titles + a positive relevance filter (LinkedIn job search is fuzzy). max_per_title is per (title x location); sort_by 'date' = freshest first.

bait_discovery._comment: Track 3: find target creators posting engagement-bait, then human-approve them into config/watchlist.json. Bait = comment/DM CTA PAIRED WITH a promised deliverable (BAIT_CTA_RE + BAIT_DELIVERABLE_RE in scrape.py); hiring posts excluded.

icp._comment: VALIDATED comp/total-rewards ICP (see docs/RUNBOOK.md for how this was tuned + verified). tier1 = decision-makers (VP/SVP/Head/Director of Total Rewards/Compensation/People/HR, in either word order); tier2 = influencers (comp/rewards/benefits/people-ops individual contributors + managers/analysts); exclude = obvious non-buyers dropped pre-enrichment. A tier match WINS over exclude (so a real exec with a stray word isn't lost). Retarget via docs/ADAPTING.md.
icp.tier1: ((chief people officer|\bchro\b|chief human resources)|(head of|vp|vice president|svp|senior director|director).{0,25}(rewards|compensation|people|human resources|\bhr\b)|(rewards|compensation|people|human resources|\bhr\b).{0,25}(head|vp|vice president|svp|director|officer|lead|leader))
icp.tier2: (rewards|compensation|comp & ben|compensation & benefits|people operations|hr business partner|\bhrbp\b|benefits manager)

pricing._comment: OPTIONAL. --estimate-only bills per returned result at these USD rates (no Apify margin). Confirm your plan's per-result cost at harvestapi.io/pricing and override; defaults in scripts/scrape.py are $0.004/result. Keys: post, reaction, comment, job, profile.
